data.name: InventoryError.InvalidInput
data.value: One or more values are not valid.

data.name: InventoryError.StorageLocationNotFound
data.value: The specified storage location was not found.

data.name: InventoryError.InventoryItemNotFound
data.value: The specified inventory item was not found.

data.name: InventoryError.StorageLocationFromAnotherProperty
data.value: The storage location belongs to a different property than the inventory item.

data.name: InventoryError.DuplicateStorageLocationCode
data.value: Another storage location of the property uses the same code.

data.name: InventoryError.DuplicateInventoryItemCode
data.value: Another inventory item of the property uses the same code.

data.name: InventoryError.StorageLocationInUse
data.value: The storage location cannot be deleted while inventory items are assigned to it.

data.name: InventoryError.StorageLocationNotAssigned
data.value: The inventory item is not assigned to the storage location.

data.name: InventoryError.StorageLocationAssignmentInUse
data.value: The primary location, or a location that keeps stock of the item, cannot be removed from it.

data.name: InventoryError.UnitChangeNotAllowed
data.value: The unit of the item cannot change after its first stock adjustment.

data.name: InventoryError.InvalidAdjustmentReason
data.value: The reason is not valid for the operation, or the note required by the other reason is missing.

data.name: InventoryError.InsufficientStock
data.value: The quantity exceeds the stock on hand in the storage location.
